option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a common manifestation of Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome, although not a diagnostic criterion itself.
RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) is the full name for the disease represented by the leaf.

Vascular malformation of the nose, specifically capillary dilation and abnormal enhancement of the inferior turbinate mucosa, is a specific manifestation of Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome.

Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes not directly related to Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome as an equivalent, subtype, or supertype.
